name: Brit 100% veg cake
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE OIL & REFINED SUNFLOWER OIL, FRUIT PRODUCTS (5.3%) GLAZED FRUITS (PAPAYA CUTS, COLOUR (124), PINEAPPLE CUTS) & ORANGE PULP, HUMECTANT (422), MILK SOLIDS, HIGH MALTOSE SYRUP, EMULSIFIERS (475 471), RAISING AGENTS [500(iii), 450(i) & 341(i)]), IODISED SALT, INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, PRESERVATIVES (202 & 282), WHEAT FIBRE ACIDITY REGULATOR (330), STABILIZER (415) AND COLOUR (102).
